name: zclass_world_get_area_partition_at_grid
description: zClass_World::GetAreaPartitionAtGrid returns a virtual-area grid cell by column and row after validating the world node and class data.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass world/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450a00 validates null world and null classData diagnostics with null returns, then computes areaGridRows[gridRow] plus gridCol * sizeof(zWorldAreaPartial).
The native world-grid accessor smoke verifies both null-return guard paths and that a populated grid returns the expected row/column cell without modifying area contents.
